facts.statement: The study found that the proteins BOC and CDON help recruit specific actin regulators to make cytonemes longer in cells that produce Sonic Hedgehog.
facts.subject: cells_or_tissue

facts.statement: When the functions of BOC and CDON were removed, the activity of Cdc42 at the tips of protrusions dropped, leading to shorter and fewer cytonemes.
facts.subject: cells_or_tissue

facts.statement: Observations of developing mouse spinal cords showed that losing CDON in SHH-producing cells made neuroepithelial cytonemes less frequent and changed how neurons develop.
facts.subject: animals

facts.statement: The authors suggest a model where proteins that bind Sonic Hedgehog help move signals by encouraging the growth of long cytonemes.
facts.subject: cells_or_tissue
